intro.en: Custom panel-mount and bulkhead cable assemblies turn a loose cable end into a defined equipment interface. Connector, panel cutout, mounting hardware, gasket, internal cable, external cable and validation are engineered as one system.
intro.zh: 定制面板安装与隔板电缆组件，将普通线端变成边界清晰的设备接口。连接器、面板开孔、固定件、密封件、内外侧线缆与验证需要作为一个系统开发。

knowledge.en: Panel mounting describes installation, not signal capability, ingress protection or an interchangeable connector family.
knowledge.zh: 面板安装描述的是安装方式，并不自动代表信号能力、防护等级或通用接口。

notes.en: Provide the exact interface, panel material and thickness, cutout drawing, mounting side, hardware, cable route, environment and test requirements.
notes.zh: 请提供准确接口、面板材料与厚度、开孔图、安装方向、紧固件、线缆路径、环境及测试要求。

delivery.en: Approve the mechanical fit, interface sample, sealing stack, circuit map and project-specific test evidence before repeat production.
delivery.zh: 重复生产前确认机械配合、接口样件、密封叠层、回路图及项目特定测试证据。

subtitle.en: Design the equipment boundary, not only the cable ends
subtitle.zh: 设计设备边界，不只是线缆两端

lead.en: A panel connector has two working sides: the user-facing mating interface and the protected internal transition. Both must fit, seal, route and remain serviceable.
lead.zh: 面板接口同时拥有两个工作面：面向用户的对插侧，以及受保护的内部过渡侧。两侧都必须满足配合、密封、布线与维护要求。

title.en: A Panel-Mount Cable Defines the Equipment Boundary
title.zh: 面板安装电缆定义设备边界

copy.en: This category includes panel-mount pigtails, bulkhead extensions, feed-through cables, flange receptacle leads, jam-nut assemblies, service ports and internal-to-external adapters. The interface can carry power, sensor signals, USB, video, Ethernet, RF or mixed circuits. Its name does not define the complete assembly; the drawing must establish both mating ends, circuit map, panel datum, cable exit and service side.
copy.zh: 这一小类包括面板尾线、隔板延长线、穿通线、法兰插座引线、锁紧螺母组件、维修接口与内外转换线，可承载电源、传感、USB、视频、以太网、RF 或混合回路。名称不能定义成品，图纸还应明确两端对插、回路表、面板基准、出线与维修侧。

title.en: Front, Rear, Jam-Nut and Flange Mounting Change the Fit
title.zh: 前装、后装、锁紧螺母与法兰会改变配合

copy.en: Front-mount, rear-mount, jam-nut, square-flange and feed-through constructions place the flange, nut, gasket and cable transition on different sides of the wall. Panel thickness, cutout diameter or profile, hole pattern, anti-rotation feature, rear clearance, mating depth and tool access belong on the interface drawing. A connector that enters the cutout can still fail to seat or lock.
copy.zh: 前装、后装、锁紧螺母、方法兰与穿通结构，会将法兰、螺母、密封件及出线过渡布置在壁面不同侧。接口图应标明面板厚度、开孔尺寸与轮廓、孔距、防转特征、后方空间、对插深度及工具操作空间。接头能穿过开孔，仍可能无法完全就位或锁紧。

title.en: Waterproof Performance Belongs to the Installed Interface
title.zh: 防水性能属于安装完成的整个接口

copy.en: A product-specific IP67, IP68 or other ingress rating is not transferred automatically to a custom cable. Performance depends on the selected connector pair, mated or capped state, gasket or O-ring, panel finish and flatness, compression, rear cable seal, assembly method and test condition. State which side faces spray, dust or immersion and whether the interface is tested mated, unmated with cap, or installed in the final enclosure.
copy.zh: 某个元件标注的 IP67、IP68 或其他防护等级，不会自动转移到定制电缆上。性能取决于选定的对插件、对插或加盖状态、密封圈或 O 形圈、面板表面与平面度、压缩量、后端线密封、装配方法与试验条件。还应说明哪一侧暴露于喷淋、粉尘或浸水，以及测试时是对插、加盖还是已安装在最终箱体中。

title.en: Fasteners and Service Access Are Part of the BOM
title.zh: 紧固件与维修空间属于 BOM

copy.en: Thumbscrews, jackscrews, latches, coupling threads, lock washers, flange screws and tethered caps determine how the user connects and services the interface. Define thread, length, head, material, torque source and retention. Verify that adjacent ports, doors and handles leave room to mate, tighten and remove the connector without pulling on the cable.
copy.zh: 手拧螺钉、锁紧螺钉、卡扣、耦合螺纹、锁紧垫圈、法兰螺钉与防丢盖共同决定用户如何插接与维护。应明确螺纹、长度、头型、材料、扭矩依据与防松方式，并验证相邻端口、门板与把手不会阻碍对插、锁紧和拆卸，不能通过拉拽线缆拔出接头。

title.en: O-Rings and Gaskets Need the Correct Compression Stack
title.zh: O 形圈与密封垫需要正确压缩叠层

copy.en: Seal material, cross-section, groove geometry, panel surface, lubricant policy and fastener load must be compatible with temperature, fluids, cleaning agents and service life. Too little compression leaves a leak path; too much can damage the seal or distort the mounting face. Treat replacement seals and caps as controlled parts, not anonymous accessories.
copy.zh: 密封材料、截面、沟槽几何、面板表面、润滑策略与紧固载荷，必须与温度、油液、清洁剂及维修寿命相容。压缩不足会留下泄漏通道，过度压缩则可能损伤密封件或使安装面变形。替换密封件与防护盖也应受料号控制，不是无名附件。

title.en: USB and USB-C Panel Extensions: Define Function Before Form
title.zh: USB 与 USB-C 面板延长：先定义功能，再定外形

copy.en: Panel-mount USB Type-A, Type-B and USB-C extensions can provide charging, data, alternate-mode or equipment-service access. Connector shape alone does not establish USB generation, power delivery, current, e-marker requirements or video capability. Define both endpoints, orientation, cable length, internal adapter path, shielding and the exact end-to-end validation required.
copy.zh: 面板安装 USB Type-A、Type-B 与 USB-C 延长线可用于充电、数据、替代模式或设备维修访问。接口形状不能自动确定 USB 代际、功率传输、电流、e-marker 需求或视频能力。应定义两个端点、方向、长度、内部转接路径、屏蔽以及所需端到端验证。

title.en: HDMI and Display Interfaces: Protect the Complete Channel
title.zh: HDMI 与显示接口：保护完整通道

copy.en: HDMI, DisplayPort, DVI and legacy video panel extensions add two connector transitions and often a compact internal route. Supported format, bandwidth, direction and auxiliary functions depend on the exact receptacle, cable, adapter construction, length and source/display system. Keep high-speed pairs, shield path and bend radius controlled, then validate the project-defined channel rather than promising capability from the port name.
copy.zh: HDMI、DisplayPort、DVI 及传统视频面板延长会增加两处连接过渡，并常伴随紧凑内部布线。所支持的格式、带宽、方向与辅助功能取决于准确插座、线缆、转接结构、长度及源端/显示系统。应控制高速线对、屏蔽路径与弯曲半径，并按项目定义验证完整通道，不以端口名称代替性能证据。

title.en: RJ45 and Ethernet Bulkheads: Keep Pair and Shield Architecture
title.zh: RJ45 与以太网隔板：保持线对与屏蔽架构

copy.en: A panel RJ45 coupler, punch-down module or pigtail changes the permanent link and service boundary. Category language such as Cat 5e, Cat 6 or Cat 6A is meaningful only when every component and termination belongs to a defined tested channel. Preserve pair twist close to termination, control shield bonding, identify PoE duty and verify the installed cable length and enclosure grounding plan.
copy.zh: 面板 RJ45 耦合器、打线模块或尾线会改变永久链路与维护边界。Cat 5e、Cat 6 或 Cat 6A 等级只有在所有元件与端接属于明确的受测通道时才有意义。应尽量将线对绞合保留至端接附近，控制屏蔽连接，识别 PoE 负载，并核对安装长度与箱体接地方案。

title.en: One Interface Pattern Serves Very Different Industries
title.zh: 同一种接口逻辑可服务不同行业

copy.en: Industrial automation uses service ports, sensor bulkheads and cabinet transitions; AV equipment uses USB, HDMI and network feed-throughs; marine and outdoor enclosures emphasize sealing and corrosion compatibility; aerospace and defense emphasize compact retention and documentation; medical and instrumentation projects emphasize cleanability, identification and controlled service. Application names guide risk review but do not replace the equipment specification or certification path.
copy.zh: 工业自动化使用维修口、传感器隔板与控制柜过渡；音视频设备使用 USB、HDMI 与网络穿通；船用与户外箱体重视密封及耐腐蚀相容性；航空航天与国防项目重视紧凑锁紧与文件；医疗和仪器项目重视清洁、识别与受控维修。行业名称可引导风险审核，但不能替代整机规范与认证路径。

title.en: High Current and Voltage Require a Thermal and Safety Design
title.zh: 大电流与较高电压需要热与安全设计

copy.en: Power panel assemblies are defined by continuous and transient load, conductor cross-section, contact resistance, terminal temperature rise, voltage drop, insulation system, creepage and clearance, enclosure temperature, protective device and touch protection. Never infer a cable rating from connector size alone. The complete current path and worst-case installed environment require project-specific limits and validation.
copy.zh: 功率面板组件需由持续与瞬态负载、导体截面、接触电阻、端子温升、压降、绝缘系统、爬电距离与电气间隙、箱体温度、保护器件与防触电共同定义。不能根据连接器大小推断整线额定能力，完整电流路径与最恶劣安装环境需要项目特定限值与验证。

title.en: Build the Panel Hardware and Cable as One Assembly
title.zh: 将面板五金与线缆作为一个组件制造

copy.en: Production can include cable cutting and stripping, crimping or soldering, shield termination, overmolding or boot installation, gasket and hardware assembly, orientation control and labeling. A first article checks panel fit, connector clocking, cable exit, internal clearance and mating access before the configuration is frozen. Work instructions should preserve the approved tool, strip dimensions, hardware stack and revision.
copy.zh: 生产可包括裁线剥线、压接或焊接、屏蔽端接、包胶或护套安装、密封与五金装配、方向控制以及标识。配置冻结前，首件需核对面板配合、接头角度、出线、内部间隙与对插操作空间。作业文件应保留已批准工具、剥线尺寸、五金叠层与版本。

title.en: Test Electrical Function, Mechanical Fit and Traceability
title.zh: 同时验证电气功能、机械配合与可追溯性

copy.en: Routine release may include visual inspection, dimensions, labels, pin-to-pin continuity, open and short checks, shield-to-shell continuity and a panel-fit gauge. Insulation resistance, dielectric withstand, insertion loss, return loss, Ethernet certification, USB or video channel tests, sealing or mechanical tests are added only when limits, fixtures and methods are agreed. Batch, drawing revision, inspection result and packing identity should remain connected.
copy.zh: 日常放行可包含外观、尺寸、标识、逐路导通、开路与短路检查、屏蔽到壳体连续性及面板配合检具。绝缘电阻、耐压、插入损耗、回波损耗、以太网认证、USB 或视频通道、密封与机械测试，仅在双方确定限值、夹具与方法时加入。批次、图纸版本、检验结果与包装标识应保持关联。

inputs.en: Exact panel connector and mating part references, plug/receptacle and contact definition
inputs.zh: 准确面板接口与对插料号、插头/插座及触点定义

inputs.en: Panel material, thickness, cutout drawing, mounting side and keep-out envelope
inputs.zh: 面板材料、厚度、开孔图、安装侧与禁布包络

inputs.en: Circuit map, signal or power duty, cable construction, shielding and grounding
inputs.zh: 回路图、信号或功率工况、线缆结构、屏蔽与接地

inputs.en: Gasket, O-ring, fasteners, cap, torque source and environmental exposure
inputs.zh: 密封垫、O 形圈、紧固件、防护盖、扭矩依据与环境暴露

inputs.en: Internal and external lengths, cable exits, bend zones, branch points and labels
inputs.zh: 内外侧长度、出线、弯曲区、分支点与标识

inputs.en: Required electrical, signal, sealing, mechanical and documentation evidence
inputs.zh: 所需电气、信号、密封、机械与文件证据

q.zh: 所有面板安装电缆都防水吗？

a.en: No. Ingress protection applies only to a defined connector, gasket, panel, installation state and test condition. Confirm which side and condition require protection.
a.zh: 不是。防护性能只适用于已定义的连接器、密封件、面板、安装状态与试验条件，必须确认哪一侧在哪种状态需要防护。

q.en: Can you build from a panel cutout and mating sample?
q.zh: 可以根据面板开孔和对插样品开发吗？

a.en: They can support mechanical identification, but circuit function, ratings, materials, mounting stack and acceptance criteria still require confirmation.
a.zh: 它们可辅助机械识别，但回路功能、额定值、材料、安装叠层与验收条件仍需确认。

q.en: Do you make USB-C, HDMI and RJ45 panel extensions?
q.zh: 可以制作 USB-C、HDMI 与 RJ45 面板延长线吗？

a.en: Yes, around specified interfaces and functions. Supported data, video, power or network performance depends on the complete defined channel and validation.
a.zh: 可以，但需围绕指定接口与功能开发。数据、视频、供电或网络性能取决于完整通道定义与验证。

q.zh: 如何确定前装还是后装？

a.en: Panel access, cutout, wall thickness, visible flange, sealing surface, rear clearance, mating direction and service procedure decide the mounting architecture.
a.zh: 面板可达性、开孔、壁厚、法兰外观、密封面、后方间隙、对插方向与维修流程共同决定安装架构。

q.en: Can a panel connector carry high current?
q.zh: 面板接口可以承载大电流吗？

a.en: Specific systems can, but the complete connector, conductor, termination, enclosure temperature, protection and test plan must support the load. Size alone is not a rating.
a.zh: 特定体系可以，但完整连接器、导体、端接、箱体温度、保护与测试计划必须支持目标负载，不能用外形大小代替额定值。

a.en: Continuity, open/short, labels, dimensions and panel fit can be defined routinely. Signal, dielectric, sealing and mechanical tests need agreed limits, fixtures and methods.
a.zh: 可常规定义导通、开路/短路、标识、尺寸与面板配合检查；信号、耐压、密封与机械测试则需事先约定限值、夹具与方法。
